inlines.v: PROPORTIONATE, adjective Adjusted to something else according to a certain rate or comparative relation; proportional. The connection between the end and means is proportionate Punishment should be proportionate to the transgression. PROPORTIONATE, verb transitive To proportion; to make proportional; to adjust according to a settled rate or to due comparative relation; as, to proportionate punishments to crimes. [This verb is less used than proportion.]
